component.name: Camera Wire Tool
component.summary: Plan security-camera placement and estimate cable runs

description.p: A desktop tool for security-camera installers: load a draw.io floor plan, place devices, draw multi-point wire routes, calibrate the real-world scale, and estimate the total cable per device plus a project-wide bill of materials.

ul.li: Cable types and BOM with waste, tax and CSV export
Camera field-of-view and DORI coverage overlays
